title: Configuration views follow actual source writers
description: On the isolated farm, actual slot/pool commands and owned template/registration file writes update mounted configuration views. Clean raw editor follows source changes; a real typed draft survives invalidation. Provider registration uses only the private FARMSLOT_HOME and no provider request.

proofTargets.claim: A real slot configuration write updates the actual structured pool controls.
Pool changes update the clean raw editor while preserving a real unsaved draft.
An atomic template replacement updates the mounted raw preview without Refresh.
An owned registration file changes its provider card without exposing its key.
Malformed registration retains visible facts with an error and disabled actions until valid recovery.

prove.intent: Prove actual pool, template and private provider-registration writers on mounted views.

pool.intent: The actual slot control follows an independent configuration command.

editor.intent: The clean raw editor updates while a dirty typed draft survives source changes.

template.intent: Atomic template replacement updates the open actual raw preview.

registration.intent: Private registration metadata updates without exposing its secret or contacting a provider.

registration-error.intent: Malformed registration retains provider facts, blocks actions and recovers after a real file repair.
